attributes.residual:
REFUTES the reclassification in attempt.CB_get-cam-wpos-five-constant-hoist-and-savefpr-alignment.20260901.v1, which concludes 'RECLASSIFIED: this function should leave the source-reconstruction queue and enter the WebFrank queue'. That conclusion does not survive measurement, and the CB record contains its own refutation: it states 'Multiset ours-only is -1 lfd -4 lis -3 mr, target-only is EMPTY', i.e. we emit EIGHT INSTRUCTIONS THE TARGET DOES NOT HAVE. Those are surplus words to be DELETED, not displaced words to be MOVED or mis-coloured words to be RE-ENCODED, and no WebFrank stage deletes an instruction.

MEASURED: fndiff --count -> insns 445/453, real 438. ha_close.py -> `refuses -- size mismatch (1812 vs 1780)`. hv_perm.py -> `size mismatch (453 vs 445)`. Both refuse at the equal-size screen, BEFORE any stage-specific analysis runs, exactly as the tooling is designed to. The function never enters the census population at all.

The --ops view confirms the residual is structural rather than positional: `insert O[183:186]@2dc-2e8=['cmpwi','bne','lis']` and `replace T[184:188]@2e0-2f0=['bne','li','addi','addi'] O[192:193]@300-304=['mr']` are whole missing/extra control-and-materialisation groups, not a schedule.

RECLASSIFIED back from postprocessor-class to SOURCE-class. The named 'combined-stage candidate sites' in the CB record (the three surplus `mr` in the matching-destination/differing-source copy class) are correctly identified as belonging to that FORM class, but a form class membership does not confer stage eligibility when the streams have different lengths -- the site cannot be addressed while seven other surplus words remain. Anyone re-queueing this function must target the eight surplus instructions (four gCameraTargets `lis`, three `mr`, one `lfd`) in source, and the CB record's own axis (i) analysis is the right starting point. NOTE that CB's separate finding stands untouched and is independently important: the 0.02f pool respell is source-correct and blocked by init_game_cam's PINNED permutation relocation hash (attempt.CB_get-cam-wpos-float-pool-respell-blocked-by-pinned-permutation.20260901.v1).

GENERAL POINT, since this is the second time in two runs a lane was handed a count-delta function labelled postprocessor-class: 'the residual is register/schedule-shaped' and 'the function is postprocessor-eligible' are different claims, and only the second requires the equal-size screen. A reclassification to postprocessor-class should quote insns N/N from a live fndiff, or it is not a reclassification.
